# MDViewer — full agent brief

> Same product as /llms.txt with API details agents need. Share protocol upgrades (password, TTL, MCP) are planned — see maintainer/phases/01-share-protocol.md and maintainer/final.md (pre-v4.0).

## Product

- SPA: `apps/web` — local files/projects in browser storage, GFM + Mermaid + KaTeX preview
- Worker: `apps/worker` — optional share upload/download on R2
- Config: public Vite defaults (`VITE_API_URL`, `VITE_FRONTEND_URL`) or Settings → Share override (http/https only)

## Public Worker API (protocol 1)

Base: `https://api.mdviewer.zamdev.dev` (or self-hosted worker)

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| GET | `/health` | `{ ok: true }` |
| GET | `/compatibility` | Versioned handshake; no secret origins leaked |
| POST | `/upload` | Create share; text/plain or multipart; rate limited |
| GET | `/share/:id` | Raw markdown text |
| GET | `/docs` | Swagger UI |
| GET | `/openapi.json` | OpenAPI document |

CORS / constructed frontend share URLs use worker `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (see `apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc`).

## Share URLs (frontend)

- `https://mdviewer.zamdev.dev/share?id=<id>`
- `https://mdviewer.zamdev.dev/share/<id>`

In-doc fragment links (`#heading`) work in editor preview and share viewer (first matching heading wins).

## Not available yet (Phase C / E — pre-v4.0)

- Password-gated mutate / optional view protection — maintainer/phases/01-share-protocol.md
- Fixed TTL + expiry cron — same
- Fair-use Durable Object beyond basic upload rate limit — same
- MCP tools on the same worker (`get_share`, `upload_share`, …) — maintainer/phases/03-agent-surfaces.md
- Worker-hosted `/llms.txt` routes (SPA hosts these files today)

Do not invent auth headers or MCP endpoints until `/compatibility` protocol bumps and docs/api.md lists them. Track release readiness in maintainer/final.md.

## Security notes

- Preview: rehype-sanitize after KaTeX; Mermaid `securityLevel: "strict"`
- Pages: CSP, X-Frame-Options DENY, COOP
- Details: https://github.com/zamdevio/mdviewer/blob/main/docs/security.md
